execution: Early in-clinic isometrics held the first metatarsophalangeal joint neutral while the therapist resisted the whole great-toe phalanx manually, without curling the interphalangeal joint. execution: The guideline allows isometric, concentric or eccentric wrist-extensor resistance for subacute or chronic lateral elbow pain. remainingGap: Select contraction type and load for the person. A still isometric hold, lifting against gravity and controlling the descent are different executions. A handled container is one published option.
